desc_long.mass: The base unit of mass in the metric system is the kilogram. Mass is one of the fundamental physical quantities, while weight is the force exerted by a body on a support. The mass converter allows converting tons, kilograms, grams, pounds, ounces and other units. The mass calculator is useful in science, construction, agriculture and everyday life. For students and researchers, an extended set of units is available: milligrams, micrograms, carats, centners and many more.
desc_long.length: The base unit of length in the metric system is the meter. Length is one of the fundamental physical quantities used everywhere: from construction to science. The length converter allows you to quickly convert between kilometers, meters, centimeters, feet, yards, inches and miles.
desc_long.temperature: The base unit of temperature in the SI system is the kelvin. However, degrees Celsius and Fahrenheit are most common in everyday life. The temperature converter allows instant conversion between Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin and Rankine.
desc_long.pressure: The base unit of pressure in the SI system is the pascal. Pressure is the force acting on a unit area. The pressure converter allows conversion between pascals, bars, atmospheres, torr and other units.
desc_long.volume: The base unit of volume in the metric system is the liter. Volume quantifies the space occupied by a body or substance. The volume converter converts liters, gallons, cubic meters and fluid ounces.
desc_long.area: The base unit of area in the metric system is the square meter. Area measures the size of a surface. The area converter converts square meters, square feet, acres, ares, square miles and other units.
desc_long.density: The base unit of density is the kilogram per cubic meter. Density determines the mass of a substance per unit volume. The density converter converts grams per liter, kilograms per cubic centimeter, pounds per cubic inch and other units.
desc_long.time: The base unit of time in the SI system is the second. Time is one of the fundamental physical quantities. The time converter converts days, hours, minutes, seconds and milliseconds.
desc_long.speed: The base unit of speed is the meter per second. Speed characterizes how fast an object moves. The speed converter converts kilometers per hour, meters per second, miles per hour and knots.
desc_long.acceleration: The base unit of acceleration is the meter per second squared. Acceleration characterizes the change in speed per unit time. The acceleration converter converts m/s² and km/s².
desc_long.force: The base unit of force in the SI system is the newton. Force measures the interaction between bodies. The force converter converts newtons, dynes, kilogram-force, gram-force and pound-force.
desc_long.angle: The base unit of angle measurement is the degree. An angle is formed by two rays from a common point. The angle converter converts degrees, radians and circles (revolutions).
desc_long.power: The base unit of power in the SI system is the watt. Power characterizes the rate of energy transfer. The power converter converts watts, kilowatts, megawatts and horsepower.
desc_long.energy: The base unit of energy in the SI system is the joule. Energy is a measure of various forms of motion and interaction of matter. The energy converter converts joules, calories, ergs, BTU and watt-hours.
desc_long.frequency: The base unit of frequency in the SI system is the hertz. Frequency quantifies repeating events per unit time. The frequency converter converts hertz, megahertz and RPM.
desc_long.computing: The base unit of information is the bit. A byte equals 8 bits. The computing units converter converts bits, bytes, kilobytes, megabytes, gigabytes and terabytes.
desc_long.current: The base unit of electric current in the SI system is the ampere. Electric current is the directed movement of electric charges. The current converter converts amperes, milliamperes and other units.
desc_long.electromagnetism: The base unit of capacitance in the SI system is the farad. Electromagnetic quantities include capacitance and other circuit parameters. The electromagnetism converter converts farads, microfarads, picofarads and statfarads.
desc_long.illuminance: The base unit of illuminance in the SI system is the lux. Illuminance quantifies the light falling on a surface. The illuminance converter converts lux, phots, lumens per square meter and meter-candles.
desc_long.brightness: The base unit of brightness in the SI system is the candela per square meter. Brightness measures light emitted from a surface. The brightness converter converts lamberts, stilbs and candelas.
